title: המגילה שנשרפה לגחל — וקראו אותה בלי לפתוח
summary: Reading the Herculaneum scrolls without opening them: Vesuvius (79) carbonised the Villa of the Papyri library (found 1752, >1,800 scrolls), Piaggio's silk-thread machine (~4 years for one scroll), X-ray absorption — metal ink shows (En-Gedi Leviticus scroll, IAA + Seales, 2016) while carbon ink vanishes, tomography and virtual unrolling of a spiral (length ≈ turns × π × mean diameter; 11–15 m), Handmer's crackle pattern and Farritor's first word ΠΟΡΦΥΡΑϹ 'purple' (2023), the 2024 grand prize (~2,000 letters, ~5%), 'On Vices' (2025) and the June 2026 full unwrap; with a 5%→whole and reading-rate challenge.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (3 rounds) — nits left: X-ray beams cross the 'בעין: שחור על שחור' label at 1100px; kit lint/check missing from the repo so local stand-ins were used; Arto and the AI grader not exercised on file://; the review copy doesn't declare the sample capability, so Arto falls back there (template)
